title.rendered: Lubo AWS StarScreen Sorting MSW Waste

content.rendered:
VAN DYK Recycling Solutions presents Lubo’s newest invention, the Anti Wrapping StarScreen®. With a throughput of up to 50 tph, it can divert 95% of < 2″ organic fines with virtually no wrapping or cleaning needs, easily change screening size to increase system flexibility, and achieve high purity with aggressive agitation.

VAN DYK presents Lubo’s newest invention, the Anti Wrapping StarScreen. With a throughput of up to 50 tph, it can divert 95% of less than 2″ organic fines with virtually no wrapping.
